statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail stands at 13 of 100 in the low band, twelve points below the 25 block threshold, while stress is extreme at 85 and confidence high at 88.
recommendation: Tail remains below the block threshold, so the deterministic mapping returns EA_ON for both NQ futures and NAS100 CFD. The named danger window spans the 12:30 UTC August consumer price report, the 13:30 UTC cash open and the 14:00 UTC preliminary Michigan release, where the conditional path peaks at WATCH without reaching the block threshold.
headline: NQ trades 29,245.00, up 0.38%, after printing a new overnight high at 29,248.75 that clears Thursday's 29,171.50 ceiling, which lifts tail to 13 while an easing Brent near $106, a 4.944% ten-year and a September rate increase priced near 70% keep stress extreme at 85 into the August consumer price report.
body:
The new evidence this hour is an upside break of the overnight band. NQ trades 29,245.00, up 109.75 points or 0.38%, with a second independent feed quoting 29,248.00 and both showing a session high of 29,248.75 against a previous close of 29,135.25. That high clears the 29,171.50 ceiling that held through the Asian session, and the 29,040.50 low has been fully retraced. Price is therefore sitting within four points of its own extreme, which is a genuine amplifier and the reason tail moves up from 11 to 13.

Two considerations keep that move small. First, the advance is 0.4% and it arrives in the thinnest liquidity of the week, hours before a top-tier release; a drift to a marginal new high in a pre-event tape is not the same structure as repeated extension after failed retracements. Second, the amplifier is isolated rather than aligned. Brent is easing about 1.4% toward $106 and WTI about 1.3% toward $101 after a sharp weekly gain, so the energy channel that drove Thursday's selling is working against the equity bid rather than with it. NVDA is quoted up around 0.5% overnight after a 2.37% regular-session loss, which reads as a partial recovery rather than a momentum extension. No shallow-pullback sequence, no failed retracement and no aligned cross-asset stack has been observed, so the reading stays deep inside the low band and the mapped policy state remains EA_ON.

The macro backdrop is unchanged and remains the reason stress is extreme at 85. The ten-year closed at 4.944% after touching 4.961%, its highest since 2023, the two-year sits near 4.57% at a two-year high, and the thirty-year reached 5.35%. Thursday's producer price report printed 0.4% month-over-month and 5.4% year-over-year against 5.3% expected, which lifted the probability of a Federal Reserve rate increase on 16 September to roughly 70 to 73% on CME FedWatch. VIX closed at 17.84, up 8.38%, which is elevated but far from a disorderly level. Oil above $100 traces to Strait of Hormuz and Red Sea disruption and to Saudi production at its lowest since 1990.

The whole session turns on the August consumer price report at 12:30 UTC. Consensus is near 0.4% headline and 0.2% core month-over-month, with headline around 3.3% to 3.4% year-over-year and core near 2.4%. That is the named danger window, extended to 14:30 UTC to cover the 13:30 UTC cash open where a post-release move is confirmed or rejected and the 14:00 UTC preliminary Michigan release with its inflation expectations component. Conditional tail peaks at 23 in the release hour, which is the watch band and still below the 25 block threshold, because event importance and forecast dispersion belong to stress and confidence until an actual price path is observed. Confidence is 88: the level, the band, the yield complex, oil, VIX, the release schedule and the consensus are all verified on current sources, and the only material gap is that no post-release path exists yet to score.

lookbackSummary: All 24 clock-hours from 06:00 UTC on 10 September to 05:00 UTC on 11 September carry a published Claude assessment, so every lookback slot is available and none is reconstructed. The window opens at tail 10 and holds a 9 to 11 band through the European morning with the mode recorded as mixed. The single excursion sits in the middle of the U.S. session: tail 14 at 11:00 UTC as the mode turned trend-down on the pre-release grind, 20 at 12:00 UTC when the August producer price report printed and the mode became event/whipsaw, and the window peak of 24 at 13:00 UTC across the cash open. Those two slots are the only ones mapped to WATCH and neither reached the 25 block threshold. Tail then decayed as price discovery stayed orderly, easing to 17 by 14:00 UTC and holding 14 to 19 through the afternoon, with event/whipsaw recorded again at 20:00 and 21:00 UTC around the cash close. From the 22:00 UTC reopen the series settles into a mixed 11 to 15 range and ends at 11 in the hour before this assessment. Stress never left the extreme band, running 80 to 87 across the whole window, and confidence stayed in the high band between 84 and 89. The shape is one event-driven excursion into the watch band followed by a clean decay, which is the profile of a market that repriced and then resumed two-way trade.
outlookSummary: The forward window covers the rest of the 11 September session and ends inside the CME weekend closure that begins at 21:00 UTC. Conditional tail starts at 13 on the observed upside break, holds 13 through the European handover and rebuilds gradually to 14, 15 and 16 as the release approaches and quoted depth conditionally thins. The window peak is 23 in the 12:00 UTC slot containing the August consumer price report, inside the watch band and below the 25 block threshold, and 22 in the 13:00 UTC slot spanning the cash open where a post-event move is confirmed or rejected. The 14:00 UTC slot carrying the preliminary Michigan release eases to 19 on the assumption that price discovery is orderly by then. The afternoon decays through 17, 15 and 14, lifts to 15 into the final cash hour and 18 across the 20:00 UTC weekly close where weekend positioning concentrates, then falls to a 5 to 6 floor for the nine closure hours in which no tradeable price path exists. Stress mirrors that shape, peaking at 92 in the release hour and falling to about 60 inside the closure, while confidence dips to 79 around the cash open because the post-release path cannot be observed in advance. Two slots are mapped to WATCH; none reaches a blocking state.
